technical-summary: The named-config store key took every --set as an operator set, including the engine.radiance_home that bc-serve adds on each installed start, so a different installed build never matched the stored entry and re-measured instead of replaying or carrying. engine.radiance_home is now excluded like layout.name and handoff.shm; the test starts under a second installed-layout build (root/releases/<tag>/radiance_home) with the runtime home passed as --set, as main.cpp does.
user-summary-candidate: A start on a newer installed build now reuses the stored measured plan instead of measuring again.
